clean-break.abc-completion.rationale: Completion moved to the daemon LSP authority.

clean-break.auto-open.rationale: The adapter owns editor presentation preferences.

clean-break.global-css.rationale: Global executable styling violated workspace ownership.

clean-break.global-js-plugin.unsupportedBehavior: Global JavaScript plugins are never loaded.

clean-break.install-verification.rationale: Native artifacts require packaged smoke verification.

clean-break.legacy-settings-update.rationale: No released state exists to migrate.
clean-break.legacy-settings-update.unsupportedBehavior: Legacy settings update commands and version marker are removed.

clean-break.log-level.rationale: Adapter logs must be redacted and structured.

clean-break.native-daemon.rationale: Parsing and rendering moved out of the extension host.

clean-break.note-categories.unsupportedBehavior: VS Code category settings are ignored.

clean-break.preview-target.rationale: Preview target is an adapter presentation choice.

clean-break.raw-html-policy.rationale: Raw HTML needs an explicit security boundary.
clean-break.raw-html-policy.unsupportedBehavior: Implicit raw HTML execution is removed.

clean-break.syntax-highlighting.rationale: Preview behavior uses one bundled client.

clean-break.workspace-authority.rationale: One daemon owns all root policies.

clean-break.workspace-css.rationale: Theme CSS is validated service-owned input.

clean-break.workspace-marker.rationale: The v1 schema is the only configuration authority.

releaseNotes.architecture-v1.adapter-settings: Adapter settings were replaced by the v1 names.
releaseNotes.architecture-v1.assets: Assets use typed bounded offline-safe delivery.
releaseNotes.architecture-v1.lsp: Language features are served by the authoritative daemon session.
releaseNotes.architecture-v1.multi-root: One daemon isolates multiple workspace authorities.
releaseNotes.architecture-v1.native-distribution: The extension ships verified native daemons.
releaseNotes.architecture-v1.preview-transport: Browser previews use token-bound loopback transport.
releaseNotes.architecture-v1.render-security: Preview and export raw HTML policies are explicit.
releaseNotes.architecture-v1.rendering: Preview targets share one bundled rendering client.
releaseNotes.architecture-v1.theme: Themes use validated workspace CSS only.
releaseNotes.architecture-v1.wasm-plugins: Legacy JavaScript plugins were removed; signed WASM is the replacement.
